f1_custom_team_2026 list: entrant_list_references=f1_2026, so Sess_Parse_EntrantList recurses into list 34 first; own entrants = 2 custom-team seats (team f1_custom_team_26 stat 488, fom_car_2026). fixed_garage_assignments f1_teams_2024.

Row count for entrants.teams (stock 358). Bounds Gdb_Find_RowByLabel: a team row at index >= count cannot be resolved by label; Sess_Parse_Entrant then reads Invalid.stat_id and crashes (B26b). B26c leaves it at 358 and repurposes team_81/team_88 inside the count.

Row count for entrants.vehicles (stock 413); read via Gdb_Init_TableCursor. Bounds BOTH enumeration (startup vehicle AI loop 0x142505f30) and label resolution (Gdb_Find_RowByLabel). Rows past it are invisible to label lookups; raising it makes startup process the added rows, and any key they lack crashes (absent-key sentinel). B26c leaves it at 413 and points entrants at stock vehicle rows.

entrants.entrant_setup_modes.entrant_setup_mode_10 (f1_custom_team_2026, stat 12).max_entrants, stock 24. The value the 2026 Grand Prix actually uses: EntrantSetupModeOverride f1_26 -> f1_custom_team_2026. Pool = list 66 = list 34 (via entrant_list_references) + 2 custom-team seats, so it must be grid+2 (28 for 26 cars). Runtime: B26c trace limit=0x18 max_entrants=24 candidates=0x1c.
